016627cce41a42cfb48db34becd7cbd8.name: Japanese Zabuton
016627cce41a42cfb48db34becd7cbd8.description: One of the object for Japanese Room Set. A Zabuton is a Japanese cushion for sitting. The zabuton is generally used when sitting on the floor, and may also be used when sitting on a chair. For a more casual setting the zabuton can be used in conjunction with a zaisu, a type of Japanese legless chair, and with or without an accompanying kyousoku, a Japanese-style armrest. Ordinarily, any place in Japan where seating is on the floor will be provided with zabuton, for sitting comfort. A typical zabuton measures 50–70 cm square and is several centimetres thick when new. Zabuton are found throughout Japan, and enter many aspects of the culture. - Freebase

Fully opaque model consists of 17,744 vertices or 34,578 tris.
Handset is 0.23 units in length for reference.

One material and three corresponding 4,096x4,096 textures are supplied:

* Albedo
* Occlusion + Roughness + Metallic
* Normal (Y+ Up)

04d0d8204db4400197ea4cc170c7cc15.name: ~ Beans ~
04d0d8204db4400197ea4cc170c7cc15.description:
These beans are organic, don't worry..... super safe to eat........

History:
Beans are one of the longest-cultivated plants. Broad beans, also called fava beans, in their wild state the size of a small fingernail, were gathered in Afghanistan and the Himalayan foothills.In a form improved from naturally occurring types, they were grown in Thailand from the early seventh millennium BCE, predating ceramics. They were deposited with the dead in ancient Egypt. Not until the second millennium BCE did cultivated, large-seeded broad beans appear in the Aegean, Iberia and transalpine Europe.In the Iliad (8th century BCE) there is a passing mention of beans and chickpeas cast on the threshing floor. ans were an important source of protein throughout Old and New World history, and still are today.
